name: Stage 44: Sandstugan to Lindbacke
description: Official Sörmlandsleden stage 44, Sandstugan to Lindbacke.
utilities: Sandstugan has a bus stop essentially at the start but official text says there is no parking at the stage start. Nearby backup stops include Visätter and Bråkarr; verify live Sörmlandstrafiken departures.
Practical car access is Svalstaskogen reserve parking near the early route, Ryssbergen/Skillerhultsvägen parking in the middle/late stage, or the Lindbacke/Gumsbacken shopping area near the end.
Ryssbergen is the main facility cluster with shelter, tap/drinking-water point, nearby toilet, viewpoints, and several access/parking options.
Lindbacke/Gumsbacken has shops and bus stops, and Nyköping C is the nearest rail anchor, roughly 1.3-1.5 km straight-line from the Lindbacke endpoint.
waterSources: Bergshammar spring after roughly 6.5 km is the first verified water point. It is a natural source, so filter/boil/treat unless current signage confirms potable water.
Ryssbergen tap/drinking-water point beside the shelter is the strongest refill on the stage, but still verify on site because taps can be seasonal or interrupted.
Svanviken/Lindbacke wetland and lakes are nature/bird habitat, not practical drinking-water sources.
notes: Sörmlandsleden does not guarantee water quality or availability; treat or filter natural sources and carry backup.
Shelters are generally free, shared, first-come, cannot be booked, and do not guarantee firewood or trash service.
In nature reserves, local camping and fire rules override allemansrätten; fires are often restricted to prepared fireplaces.

Official Sörmlandsleden distance is 12 km, Naturkartan lists 12.0 km/11.8 km route geometry, Äventyrligare lists 11.42 km, OSM relation 3696304 measures about 12.15 km, and the local app GeoJSON measures about 12.13 km. Use 12 km as the catalog/planning distance.

Easy/green stage: forest edge/open views after Sandstugan, Hult/easy forest, more rolling forest, gravel-road sections, Kilaån context, Iron Age grave field and labyrinth, Stora Kungsladugården, and Lindbacke/Svanviken bird-rich pasture/wetland near the end.

Stage topology is busy: stage 36:3 joins from Fada/Bergshammar, 44:1 branches toward Oxelösund/Jogersö near Ryssbergen/Skillerhultsvägen, 44:2 branches from Stora Kungsladugården toward Hållet/stage 45 in Naturkartan/OSM and older official references, and the main route continues to stage 45 at Lindbacke. Show these as related options when the relevant main-route section is selected.

There is a naming/version caveat for 44:2: Stage 44 still references a Kungsladugården-Hållet connector, Naturkartan/OSM retain that longer connector, but the current official 44:2 URL resolves to the shorter 45:2 Blommenhof-Hållet route. Keep this visible so users do not accidentally plan the wrong connector.

Independent route audits confirmed clean joins: stage 43 ends at the stage 44 start, stage 44 ends at the stage 45 start, stage 36:3 joins stage 44 near Bergshammar, and stage 44:1 meets stage 44 near Ryssbergen/Skillerhultsvägen. For route-builder snapping, use OSM nodes 3198909965 at 58.703434,16.874178, 3223700234 at 58.744822,16.994087, 914036955 at 58.729103,16.911059, 3074881314 at 58.734840,16.955879, and legacy 44:2 node 1868989042 at 58.746109,16.968913.

Official text says the route has been rerouted shortly after Sandstugan because of bark-beetle damage. Svalstaskogen reserve also warns that dead spruce can fall; avoid dead-spruce areas in wind. The official stage page showed no separate reported faults during the 2026-04-27 verification pass.

Svalstaskogen reserve rules: do not damage living or dead trees, collect only ordinary berries/edible mushrooms/personal flowers, bring your own wood for any permitted fire, and get permission for organized camps/competitions.

Svanviken-Lindbacke reserve rules are strict: no tenting, no caravans, no fires, dogs leashed, do not disturb birdlife, and do not damage vegetation or ground. Länsstyrelsen currently warns that the Kilaån footbridge is closed as unsafe; older local reports already described worn bridge/boardwalk conditions and confusing lowland route choices.

Ryssbergen reserve rules found in this pass: dogs leashed on exercise/riding trails and no riding on prepared exercise tracks. No blanket Ryssbergen tent/fire ban was verified from the reserve source.
Ryssbergen water is well listed by official/OSM sources, but no independent hiker report verified year-round tap reliability. Treat both the tap and Bergshammar spring as verify-on-site water points.

Cattle may graze at Lindbacke in summer; local reports mention manure, stiles, fence crossings, ticks, mud, wet passages, and seasonal overgrowth as practical nuisances in the grazed/wet lowland areas. Use gates carefully, keep dogs controlled, and give animals space.

facilities.name: Svalstaskogen reserve parking

facilities.name: Hult forest transition
facilities.description: Approximate route note: official text says the route enters easier forest after Hult, then becomes hillier after about 3 km.

facilities.name: Bergshammar spring
facilities.description: Official natural spring after roughly 6.5 km; OSM places the drinking-water point at nearly the same coordinate. Practical dry-period reliability was not independently verified, so treat/filter unless current signage confirms potable water.

facilities.name: Kilaån and Iron Age grave-field context
facilities.description: Approximate heritage/landscape context from the official route text: Kilaån crossing area, Iron Age grave field, old milestone, and nearby wet lowland. Look but do not disturb, and expect grass/nettle/tick-prone passages in season.

facilities.name: Ryssbergen shelter
facilities.description: Main shelter/rest point on the stage, with nearby tap and fireplace/grill context. Shared, first-come; no guaranteed space. Recent organized-walk reports used it as a coffee stop.

facilities.name: Ryssbergen tap / drinking water
facilities.description: Mapped drinking-water/tap point beside the Ryssbergen shelter; official stage text says tap at the shelter area. Seasonality/reliability was not independently verified, so verify on site.

facilities.name: Ryssbergen shelter fireplace context
facilities.description: Shelter/fireplace context reported by shelter sources and general Sörmlandsleden shelter guidance. Use only when current fire rules allow.

facilities.name: Ryssbergen / Ryssbergsbacken toilet

facilities.name: Ryssbergen west parking
